constraints: Create an operational_slice for post-merge live-stack verification of the merged multitenant onboarding work on main. Actor: operator/maintainer. Outcome: durable evidence proves the merged tenant-scoped onboarding/admin/subscription paths run against the local live stack, or records exact runtime blockers. Entrypoints: frontend/webspa-admin admin tenant workspace flow, services/acquisition-api admin tenant/account surface, services/subscription-external tenant routing/subscription request surface, and vNext control-plane gates. Trigger: next-session handoff dated 2026-06-08 lists known risk "Full live-stack browser/API proof against running services was not rerun after the merge." Allowed scope: verification commands, runtime smoke evidence, docs/agent verification note, agent/state evidence/result capsule, and .harness run artifacts. Forbidden scope: dependency manifests, migrations, compose files, secrets, production config, and product-code edits unless a separate fresh defect GoalSpec/WorkOrder is created. Acceptance proof: run or attempt the local stack with documented command/cwd, perform browser/API smoke against the tenant-scoped admin/onboarding/subscription path when services are available, run agent-hub schema validate-all --root . --json, agent-hub reconcile --root . --check --json, agent-hub dispatch ready --root . --out <artifact> --json, and record a result capsule/evidence ledger entry. If credentials/tools/services are unavailable, the proof must include the exact command, exit/status, and blocker class.
Use capsule-first context for dispatched agents.
